Also fixed local speculative state and movement display before successful OutboundCommandQueue push: failed full reliable-only queue now rolls back local yaw and flight, publishes no fake moving control flags, and does not pretend server motion. Native 114-byte LLUDP quaternion and queue-full TURN/Fly regression, Python real app wiring and full Mint x64 GUI validation. Previous Alpha794 Pi5 exact SHA 567d7a3 run 39827583351 success. Authenticated NexVerse own Low158/COF/Outfit/Skin GPU and server-confirmed WASD/yaw inworld E2E still open; no deploy.
